title: F. Love at Cafe Liebe (Easy Version)

legend: This is the easy version of the problem. The problems differ in their constraints and input formats. A solution to one may not work for the other.

Kanako-chan loves Hime-chan secretly, so she wants to give her as much coffee as possible (Hime is a caffeine addict). There are n$$$n$$$ types of coffee numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, but Hime is only interested in type 1$$$1$$$.

Kanako was offered help by Sumika-senpai. Sumika has an unlimited supply of certain types of coffee. Specifically, you are given a binary string s$$$s$$$ of length n$$$n$$$, where si=1$$$s_i = 1$$$ if and only if Sumika has coffee of type i$$$i$$$. Kanako can ask for any non-negative real amount of coffee of each type that Sumika has, as long as the total volume of coffee she requests is at most v$$$v$$$.

After getting some coffee from Sumika, Kanako can then trade with other customers at Cafe Liebe. In particular, there are m$$$m$$$ customers willing to trade. To trade with the i$$$i$$$-th customer, Kanako must do the following:
Choose a non-negative real number k$$$k$$$.
Give the customer kai$$$ka_i$$$ cups of coffee xi$$$x_i$$$ and kbi$$$kb_i$$$ cups of coffee yi$$$y_i$$$.
In return, the customer will give Kanako kci$$$kc_i$$$ cups of coffee zi$$$z_i$$$.
Kanako can trade with customers as many times as she wants. What is the maximum amount of coffee of type 1$$$1$$$ she can obtain?
input: Input consists of multiple tests. The first line contains t$$$t$$$, the number of tests (1≤t≤50$$$1 \le t \le 50$$$).

The first line of each test contains n$$$n$$$, m$$$m$$$, and v$$$v$$$  — the number of coffee types, the number of customers, and the maximum amount of starting coffee (1≤n≤50$$$1 \le n \le 50$$$, 0≤m≤103$$$0 \le m \le 10^3$$$, 1≤v≤1018$$$1 \le v \le 10^{18}$$$).
The second line contains a string s$$$s$$$ of length n$$$n$$$ consisting of 0s and 1s. The i$$$i$$$-th character is 1 if and only if Sumika has coffee of type i$$$i$$$.

The next m$$$m$$$ lines contain 6$$$6$$$ integers each: ai$$$a_i$$$, xi$$$x_i$$$, bi$$$b_i$$$, yi$$$y_i$$$, ci$$$c_i$$$, and zi$$$z_i$$$, describing their trades (1≤xi,yi,zi≤n$$$1 \le x_i, y_i, z_i \le n$$$, 1≤ai,bi≤5$$$1 \le a_i, b_i \le 5$$$, ci=1$$$c_i = 1$$$). It is guaranteed that xi$$$x_i$$$, yi$$$y_i$$$, and zi$$$z_i$$$ are all distinct.
In the easy version, it always holds that ci=1$$$c_i = 1$$$.
output: For each test, output a floating-point number, the answer.
Your answer is considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$.
Formally, let your answer be a$$$a$$$, and the jury's answer be b$$$b$$$. Your answer is accepted if and only if |a−b|max(1,|b|)≤10−6$$$\frac{|a - b|}{\max{(1, |b|)}} \le 10^{-6}$$$.
note: In the first test, you can ask for 8$$$8$$$ cups of type-2 coffee and 12$$$12$$$ cups of type-3 coffee. Then, you trade with customer 1$$$1$$$ using k=4$$$k=4$$$, and thus recieve 4$$$4$$$ cups of type-1 coffee. We can show this is the maximum achievable.
In the second test, we cannot obtain any coffee of any type no matter what, so we output 0$$$0$$$.

Kanako-chan 暗恋 Hime-chan，因此她想尽可能多地给 Hime 提供咖啡(Hime 是咖啡因成瘾者)。有 n$$$n$$$ 种咖啡，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$，但 Hime 只对 1$$$1$$$ 号咖啡感兴趣。

Sumika-senpai 主动提出帮助 Kanako。Sumika 有无限量的某些种类的咖啡。具体来说，给定一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的 01 串 s$$$s$$$，当且仅当 Sumika 有 i$$$i$$$ 号咖啡时，si=1$$$s_i = 1$$$。Kanako 可以向 Sumika 索取任意非负实数数量的每种 Sumika 持有的咖啡，但所索取咖啡的总体积不得超过 v$$$v$$$。
从 Sumika 那里得到一些咖啡后，Kanako 就可以在 Cafe Liebe 与其他顾客进行交易。具体来说，有 m$$$m$$$ 位顾客愿意进行交易。若要与第 i$$$i$$$ 位顾客交易，Kanako 必须执行以下操作：
选择一个非负实数 k$$$k$$$。
给该顾客 kai$$$ka_i$$$ 杯 xi$$$x_i$$$ 类型的咖啡，以及 kbi$$$kb_i$$$ 杯 yi$$$y_i$$$ 类型的咖啡。
作为回报，该顾客会给 Kanako kci$$$kc_i$$$ 杯 zi$$$z_i$$$ 类型的咖啡。
Kanako 可以根据需要与顾客进行任意多次交易。她最多可以获得多少杯 1$$$1$$$ 类型的咖啡？

input.ai: 输入包含多组测试数据。第一行包含 t$$$t$$$，表示测试数据的组数(1≤t≤50$$$1 \le t \le 50$$$)。
每个测试用例的第一行包含 n$$$n$$$、m$$$m$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$，分别表示咖啡的种类数、顾客数和初始咖啡的最大数量(1≤n≤50$$$1 \le n \le 50$$$，0≤m≤103$$$0 \le m \le 10^3$$$，1≤v≤1018$$$1 \le v \le 10^{18}$$$)。
第二行包含一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的字符串 s$$$s$$$，由 0 和 1 组成。当且仅当 Sumika 拥有第 i$$$i$$$ 种咖啡时，第 i$$$i$$$ 个字符为 1。

接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行每行包含 6$$$6$$$ 个整数：ai$$$a_i$$$、xi$$$x_i$$$、bi$$$b_i$$$、yi$$$y_i$$$、ci$$$c_i$$$ 和 zi$$$z_i$$$，描述对应的交易(1≤xi,yi,zi≤n$$$1 \le x_i, y_i, z_i \le n$$$，1≤ai,bi≤5$$$1 \le a_i, b_i \le 5$$$，ci=1$$$c_i = 1$$$)。保证 xi$$$x_i$$$、yi$$$y_i$$$ 和 zi$$$z_i$$$ 两两不同。
在简单版本中，始终满足 ci=1$$$c_i = 1$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个浮点数作为答案。
如果你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$，则会被判定为正确。
形式化地，设你的答案为 a$$$a$$$，评测方的答案为 b$$$b$$$。当且仅当 |a−b|max(1,|b|)≤10−6$$$\frac{|a - b|}{\max{(1, |b|)}} \le 10^{-6}$$$ 时，你的答案才会被接受。

note.ai: 在第一个测试中，你可以要 8$$$8$$$ 杯 2$$$12$$$ 型咖啡和 12$$$1$$$ 杯 3$$$k=4$$$ 型咖啡。然后，你用 k=4$$$4$$$ 与顾客 1 交易，从而得到 4 杯 1 型咖啡。可以证明这是能够达到的最大值。
在第二个测试中，无论如何都无法获得任何类型的咖啡，因此输出 0$$$0$$$。
